title: Scaled Fourier coefficient function
statement: For a function $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb R$, define its bent dual at $\gamma\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$ to be $2^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$ times the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
caveat: The definition and normalization of the vector Fourier coefficient are not included in the supplied snippet.
